in_sanskrit.name: Cm
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Cm एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Caturmasya,’ which refers to the four auspicious months of the Hindu calendar. The name signifies the blessings and grace of the gods during these holy months. It is believed that a child named Cm will be blessed with good fortune and prosperity throughout their life.
